name: Remove Nth Node from End
description: Removes the nth node from the end of a linked list in one pass using two pointers with a gap of n nodes.
aim: Delete the nth-from-last node by maintaining two pointers exactly n nodes apart — when the fast pointer reaches the end, the slow pointer is just before the target.
howItWorks: Create a dummy node pointing to head
Move fast pointer n+1 steps ahead
Move both pointers together until fast reaches end
slow.next is the node to remove

realWorld: Sliding window deletion in data streams
Cache eviction by position from end
whenToUse: Remove element by position from end without knowing length
alternatives: Two-pass: find length, then delete at len-n — simpler but two passes
Recursive — elegant but O(n) stack space
